1.Title: CPU Core Unpark & Power Plan Lock
1.Tip: Prevents CPU cores from sleeping during games, locking full sustained clock speeds.

11.Title: Disable Power Throttling

12.Title: Disable Fast Startup Memory Leak

1.Title: CPU Core Unpark & Power Plan Lock
1.Tip: Prevents CPU cores from sleeping during games, locking full sustained clock speeds.

2.Title: Game Booster Turbo Mode
2.Tip: Closes heavy background browsers, Discord, Spotify and releases RAM before gaming.

3.Title: RAM & Standby Cache Purge

4.Title: Universal GPU Shader Cache Purge
4.Tip: Cleans bloated DirectX, NVIDIA DXCache, AMD DxCache and Intel shader caches.

5.Title: Enable HAGS (Hardware GPU Scheduling)
5.Tip: Hands GPU scheduling directly to graphics hardware processor, boosting FPS.

6.Title: Lock DirectX MaxFrameLatency=1

7.Title: Force Fullscreen Optimizations (FSE)

8.Title: Disable Game DVR Background Recording

9.Title: Lighten DWM Transparency & Blur

10.Title: Set GDI Process Handle Quota to 65536

11.Title: Disable Power Throttling

12.Title: Disable Fast Startup Memory Leak
